【参考范文 · 177 词】写作无唯一标准答案，以下为达标示范
Nowadays parents are increasingly aware that allowing kids more freedom to explore and learn on their own helps foster their independence and boost their confidence. This shift in parenting reflects a valuable truth: children grow strongest not when every step is arranged for them, but when they are trusted to try, fail, and try again.
To begin with, freedom teaches independence in a way no lecture ever could. A child who is allowed to plan a weekend trip, cook a simple meal, or solve a quarrel with friends gradually learns to rely on his own judgment. Take my younger cousin, for example. When his mother stopped correcting his every homework mistake and let him check the answers himself, his grades slowly improved, and, more importantly, he began tackling new problems without fear. Each small success became a brick building his confidence.
In this way, granting children the room to explore freely is not a risk but a wise investment. As a result, they mature into adults who dare to think, decide, and stand on their own feet.

lines.en: W: So, I've been thinking, this summer, instead of our usual holiday rental, I'd like to try renting a camper van and exploring a bit more.
lines.zh: W: 我一直在想，今年夏天，我们不如不租平常那种度假屋，试试租一辆露营车，到处多探索一下。

lines.en: M: A camper van? You mean to spend the summer living out of a car?
lines.zh: M: 露营车？你的意思是整个夏天都住在车里？

lines.en: W: Yes, a camper van. And no, it's nothing like living out of a car. These are proper vans with full-size beds to sleep in. Some even have kitchens. This way, we wouldn't have to be locked into one place during our holiday. We'd be able to visit so many more places and travel at our own pace. The rates of most hotels and holiday homes really soar in the summer anyway. We'd probably save a lot of money as well.
lines.zh: W: 对，露营车。不过，这跟住在车里完全不是一回事。这种车是真正的厢式车，里面有全尺寸的床可以睡，有些甚至还带厨房。这样一来，度假的时候我们就不用被固定在一个地方了。我们可以多去很多地方，按照自己的节奏旅行。反正夏天大多数酒店和度假屋的价格都会大幅上涨。这样我们可能还能省下一大笔钱。

lines.en: M: I think my grandfather had a van like that. It doesn't sound that appealing to me.
lines.zh: M: 我觉得我爷爷以前就有一辆那样的车。听起来对我没那么有吸引力。

lines.en: W: Today's camper vans are completely different. These days, they're equipped with all the modern comforts. I've seen quite a few with solar panels that provide electricity for when you're stopped. This way, you can still use your computer or charge your phone. And most even have Wi-Fi, so if the weather's not great, you could stream videos.
lines.zh: W: 现在的露营车完全不一样了。如今，它们都配备了各种现代化的舒适设施。我见过不少装有太阳能电池板的露营车，停车时可以用来供电。这样你仍然可以使用电脑或给手机充电。而且大多数车甚至还配有 Wi-Fi，所以如果天气不太好，你还可以在线看视频。

lines.en: M: I'm warming up to the idea. Keep talking.
lines.zh: M: 我开始有点接受这个想法了。继续说。

lines.en: W: Loads of people are committing to this trend full time. Check it out online. Lots of people stream videos of their alternative lifestyles and actually earn a salary. Imagine having that kind of freedom to go anywhere you want and work from anywhere in the world.
lines.zh: W: 现在有很多人全职投入这种生活方式。你可以上网看看。很多人把自己的另类生活方式拍成视频直播，实际上还能赚到工资。想想看，要是能拥有那样的自由，想去哪儿就去哪儿，还能在世界任何地方工作，那该多好。

lines.en: M: Okay, we can consider it. As long as the basic needs like toilet and showers are covered, I'm definitely in. Do you think there will be enough room for my mountain bike? What about food delivery? Will we be able to order at the van? Will there be enough space for the dog? We wouldn't want to leave him behind.
lines.zh: M: 好吧，我们可以考虑一下。只要厕所和淋浴之类的基本需求能得到满足，我肯定参加。你觉得我的山地车有足够的地方放吗？那食物配送呢？我们能在露营车这里点外卖吗？狗狗有足够的空间吗？我们可不想把它丢在家里。

lines.en: W: Slow down. Glad you're excited about it. Let's start by looking at what's available first.
lines.zh: W: 别急。很高兴你这么兴奋。我们先看看现在有哪些选择吧。

lines.en: W: You wanted to see me?
lines.zh: W: 你找我？

lines.en: M: Yes, I'll get straight to the point. Over the past month or so, it has become apparent that your performance has dipped. You've been late to work several times these past few weeks, which is very uncharacteristic of you. But what really concerns me is your curtailed output. Lately, you seem to be constantly one step behind. What's going on?
lines.zh: M: 是的，我就直说了。过去一个月左右，很明显你的工作表现有所下滑。最近几周你迟到过好几次，这很不像平时的你。但真正让我担心的是你的工作产出减少了。最近你似乎总是慢人一步。到底怎么回事？

lines.en: W: I'm sorry. I'm going through some unfortunate family issues at the moment. It's a personal matter, so if you don't mind, I much prefer we don't get into it. Nevertheless, I expect it to have all blown over in another month or so.
lines.zh: W: 对不起。我最近正面临一些不幸的家庭问题。这是私事，所以如果你不介意的话，我很希望我们不要谈这个。不过，我预计再过一个月左右，一切应该就会平息下来。

lines.en: M: Do you need some time off?
lines.zh: M: 你需要请一段时间假吗？

lines.en: W: Actually, yes. Would it be possible to take the next two Mondays off? I was deliberating whether I should ask for this, but now that we're here…
lines.zh: W: 其实，是的。下两个星期一我可以请假吗？我之前一直在犹豫要不要提出这个请求，不过既然我们现在谈到这儿了……

lines.en: M: Sure thing. But if you needed some leave, why didn't you ask for it earlier?
lines.zh: M: 当然可以。但如果你需要休假，为什么不早点申请呢？

lines.en: W: I'm not sure why. I guess I kind of felt bad asking for it.
lines.zh: W: 我也不知道为什么。我想我只是觉得提出休假请求不太好。

lines.en: M: You shouldn't feel bad asking for leave, especially if you need it.
lines.zh: M: 你不应该因为请假而感到不好意思，尤其是在你确实需要休假的时候。

lines.en: W: I know. You're right. I'm sorry.
lines.zh: W: 我知道。你说得对。对不起。

lines.en: M: Look, you've been with us almost five years and I personally really value your proficiency at your job. It makes my job far easier. In addition, I can assure you that management as a whole also holds you in high regard.
lines.zh: M: 听着，你在我们这儿工作快五年了，而我个人确实非常看重你的工作能力。这让我的工作轻松多了。另外，我可以向你保证，管理层整体上也非常认可你。

lines.en: W: Thank you.
lines.zh: W: 谢谢。

lines.en: M: What I need is for you to be back at your 100%. Are you sure taking two Mondays off will suffice?
lines.zh: M: 我需要的是你恢复到百分之百的状态。你确定只休两个星期一就够了吗？

lines.en: W: It'll be enough. I'm sure of it.
lines.zh: W: 够了。我确定。

lines.en: M: Okay, good. So this is what we're going to do. You will take those days off, and I expect that you will gradually come back to your usual self. Then in two months' time, we will catch up again to see how you are faring.
lines.zh: M: 好，那就好。我们这样安排：你把那几天休掉，我希望你能逐渐恢复到平时的状态。两个月后，我们再聊一次，看看你目前的情况。

lines.en: W: Sounds good. Thank you for your understanding.
lines.zh: W: 听起来不错。谢谢你的理解。

lines.en: There are many factors that impact our health. These include our finances, our emotions and the way we work. Education is one such factor. Research suggests that higher levels of education can lead to better health and even greater longevity. But what about the education of your partner? New research seeks to answer this question. Researchers use data from a longitudinal study. The data came from surveys first administered to high school seniors in 1957. The surveys ended in 2011. The team found that a person whose spouse had a higher level of education tended to report better health. This remained the case when adjusting for other factors, such as participants' own education, social background and health status before and after marriage. The authors suggest that high levels of education provide shared social, intellectual, emotional and financial resources. These include things like higher levels of emotional intelligence, particular skills or knowledge, or more money. The researchers concede that an individual's own level of education is clearly important for their health, but they assert that individuals also can reap the benefits of their partner's education. It is noteworthy that the effects vary by gender. For women, health was more closely correlated to their spouse's education than for men. The team suggests this may be related to the time period of the study. Women in this sample had lower levels of education and lower occupational achievements than the men. The researchers' hypothesis is that this made the husband's resources more likely to have a shared impact.
lines.zh: 有许多因素会影响我们的健康，包括我们的经济状况、情绪以及工作方式。教育就是其中一个因素。研究表明，较高的教育水平可能带来更好的健康状况，甚至更长的寿命。那么，伴侣的教育水平又会怎样呢？一项新的研究试图回答这个问题。研究人员使用了一项纵向研究的数据。这些数据来自1957年首次对高中毕业生进行的调查，调查于2011年结束。研究团队发现，配偶受教育程度较高的人往往会报告更好的健康状况。在对其他因素进行调整后，这一情况依然成立，这些因素包括参与者自身的教育程度、社会背景，以及婚前和婚后的健康状况。研究作者认为，较高的教育水平能够提供共享的社会、智力、情感和经济资源。这些资源包括更高的情商、特定的技能或知识，或者更多的钱。研究人员承认，个人自身的教育水平显然对其健康很重要，但他们指出，个人也能从伴侣的教育水平中获益。值得注意的是，这些影响因性别而异。对女性而言，健康状况与配偶教育水平的相关性比男性更密切。研究团队认为，这可能与研究所处的时代有关。该样本中的女性教育水平较低，职业成就也低于男性。研究人员的假设是，这使得丈夫所拥有的资源更有可能对夫妻双方产生共同影响。

lines.en: Climate scientists predict that many parts of the world will be increasingly prone to floods. This is a serious risk to human lives and property. So understanding and accurately forecasting flood risks is a key challenge for vulnerable cities around the globe. In 2017, Derek Loftis of the Virginia Institute of Marine Science started a project called Catch the King. It uses a smartphone app to collect the data of ordinary citizens during high tides. He'll use those data to validate and improve his mathematical flooding model, called TideWatch. Loftis's mission is to know where the water goes before it goes there. But collecting necessary data and then processing that information quickly enough to make usable forecasts is anything but easy. Accurate flood forecasts require an understanding of the situation on the ground. By the early 2000s, supercomputing had advanced enough that scientists could integrate weather forecasting models with such measurements. But they still didn't have the critically important ability to forecast fast-moving floods in real time. So, in 2017, Loftis and colleagues set up a group of 28 Internet-connected water-level sensors throughout the flood risk community of Norfolk, Virginia. The new sensors relayed rough measurements about water height and movement to a computer at the Virginia Institute. Along with those sensors, hundreds of local citizens take photos of rising tides and transmit them in real time to the institute. Scientists hope that the data collected by these citizens can help sharpen the ability to forecast exactly when and where damaging floods will occur.
lines.zh: 气候科学家预测，世界许多地区将越来越容易发生洪水。这对人类生命和财产构成严重风险。因此，了解并准确预测洪水风险，是全球易受影响城市面临的关键挑战。2017年，弗吉尼亚海洋科学研究所的德里克·洛夫蒂斯启动了一个名为“Catch the King”的项目。该项目利用一款智能手机应用，在高潮期间收集普通市民提供的数据。他将利用这些数据验证并改进自己的数学洪水模型，该模型名为“TideWatch”。洛夫蒂斯的使命，是在水流到某处之前弄清楚它将流向哪里。然而，收集必要的数据，并随后足够迅速地处理这些信息，以便做出可用的预报，绝非易事。准确的洪水预报需要了解地面实际情况。到21世纪初，超级计算技术已经发展到足以让科学家将天气预报模型与此类测量数据结合起来。但他们仍然不具备实时预测快速移动洪水这一至关重要的能力。因此，2017年，洛夫蒂斯和同事在弗吉尼亚州诺福克的洪水风险社区内设置了一个由28个联网水位传感器组成的网络。新传感器将有关水位高度和移动情况的粗略测量结果传送到弗吉尼亚海洋科学研究所的一台计算机上。除了这些传感器之外，数百名当地市民还拍摄潮水上涨的照片，并将照片实时传送给该研究所。科学家希望，这些市民收集的数据能够帮助提高预测能力，从而准确预报破坏性洪水将在何时何地发生。

lines.en: Now, it's become something of a ritual to debate the value of a college degree, but as Current Population Survey data show, there has been a sharp decline in employment among men without college degrees compared with those who have them. This decline began in the 1960s and has become more serious over time.
lines.zh: 如今，讨论大学学位价值已经成了某种惯例，但正如当前人口调查数据显示的那样，与拥有大学学位的男性相比，没有大学学位的男性就业率出现了大幅下降。这种下降始于20世纪60年代，并且随着时间推移变得更加严重。

lines.en: What has actually caused this decline? Well, economists have been working to ascertain the roots of the decline for decades and have come up with several theories. One popular theory is that it's a case of too low wages for jobs that don't require a degree. An alternate theory is that there were more jobs not requiring a college degree in the past than now.
lines.zh: 究竟是什么导致了这种下降？几十年来，经济学家一直在努力探究其根源，并提出了几种理论。一种流行的理论认为，这是因为不要求大学学位的工作薪资过低。另一种理论则认为，过去不要求大学学位的工作比现在更多。

lines.en: A recent working paper from the National Bureau of Economic Research reviewed those theories and put forward additional hypotheses about the causes of the problem. Let's look at that paper now. First, the researchers considered the issue of wages. As the wage gap has grown between those with college degrees and those without, economists have suggested that men aren't as interested in taking some of the less lucrative jobs. While the authors of the paper found truth in this explanation, they assert that low wages can't be the only factor, as wages for men without college degrees, adjusting for inflation, haven't changed much since the 1960s, making it hard to see why fewer men seem willing to accept those wages.
lines.zh: 美国国家经济研究局最近的一篇工作论文审视了这些理论，并进一步提出了有关这一问题成因的其他假设。现在让我们来看看这篇论文。首先，研究人员考察了工资问题。由于大学毕业者与未获得大学学位者之间的工资差距不断扩大，经济学家认为，男性对从事一些收入较低的工作不再那么感兴趣。虽然论文作者发现这种解释有一定道理，但他们断言，低工资不可能是唯一因素，因为没有大学学位男性的工资按通货膨胀调整后，自20世纪60年代以来并没有太大变化，这使人们难以理解为什么似乎有更少的男性愿意接受这样的工资。

lines.en: This leads to the second theory, that more jobs require a college degree today than in the past. Indeed, that theory seems valid, because in America today, 2/3 of jobs are filled by workers with at least some college education. However, the authors of the paper argue that there are other factors amplifying the problem.
lines.zh: 这就引出了第二种理论，即如今比过去有更多的工作要求求职者拥有大学学位。事实上，这一理论似乎是成立的，因为在今天的美国，三分之二的工作由至少接受过部分大学教育的劳动者担任。然而，论文作者认为，还有其他因素加剧了这一问题。

lines.en: They identified two new potential explanations: the first being the tremendous decline in marriage among men without college degrees since the 1960s; and the second being the increase in women participating in the workforce that was concurrent with the decline in marriage. These two changes mean that men might not have families to support, or if they do, their wives might be doing more of the providing, both of which might remove the financial incentive to work. The authors of the paper concede that research on the subject isn't complete, but they argue that their work supports the value of a college education.
lines.zh: 他们找出了两种新的潜在解释：第一，自20世纪60年代以来，没有大学学位男性的结婚率大幅下降；第二，女性参与劳动力市场的比例有所上升，而这一变化与结婚率下降同时发生。这两种变化意味着，男性可能没有需要供养的家庭；即使有，他们的妻子也可能承担了更多供养家庭的责任，而这两种情况都可能削弱男性工作的经济激励。论文作者承认，对这一问题的研究尚未完成，但他们认为，其研究成果支持接受大学教育的价值。

lines.en: While an increasing number of people are trying to eat less meat, a market research team has found in its latest fashion and sustainability report that the trend is now spreading from kitchen to closet. It found animal welfare came top of a list of issues that people considered before buying clothes, with 42% saying it was important to them. The researchers of the team predicted that the next year would see a boom in animal-free shoe collections, since they heard shoppers of all ages say they would buy footwear designated as "vegan", meaning the goods were produced without using any animal or animal part.
lines.zh: 尽管越来越多的人正在努力少吃肉，但一个市场研究团队在其最新的时尚与可持续发展报告中发现，这一趋势如今正从厨房蔓延到衣柜。报告发现，在人们购买服装前考虑的一系列问题中，动物福利位居首位，42%的人表示这对他们很重要。该团队的研究人员预测，明年不使用动物材料的鞋类系列将迎来蓬勃发展，因为他们听到各个年龄段的消费者都表示愿意购买标有“纯素”字样的鞋类，这意味着这些商品的生产没有使用任何动物或动物的一部分。

lines.en: As well as being on trend, and with a much better ring to it than synthetic leather, the vegan label does convey an important extra distinction. If you label something as vegan, then the whole product needs to be animal free. That means checking things like the glue that holds the shoe together, for example, and the chemicals used for finishing them. At the top end, some of the world-renowned fashion designers have avoided leather and fur for some time. In fact, some of the companies are now exploring a leather substitute and a silk replacement made from mushrooms.
lines.zh: 除了符合潮流，而且比“合成皮革”听起来悦耳得多之外，“纯素”这一标签确实传达了一个重要的额外区别。如果将某件商品标为纯素，那么整件产品都必须不含动物成分。这意味着，例如，需要检查用于粘合鞋子的胶水，以及用于进行表面处理的化学品。在高端领域，一些世界知名的时装设计师已经有一段时间不再使用皮革和皮草。事实上，其中一些公司如今正在探索用蘑菇制成的皮革替代品和丝绸替代品。

lines.en: The Animal Free Product Society says they've seen a boom in products registered with the vegan trademark. In 2018, there were 119. So far this year, it says an unprecedented 1,956 have been registered. New products are being added daily. There are fur coats that are vegan, plastic vegan belts and shoes made from tree bark or natural rubber labelled vegan. These new products aren't coming at an extra cost to consumers though. Vegan boots cost the same as the leather originals. New Look, one of the first reputable store chains to use the vegan trademark, prices ballet shoes at £7.99 and a vegan laptop handbag at £29.99, comparable with its other products.
lines.zh: Animal Free Product Society表示，他们看到注册纯素商标的产品数量激增。2018年，这类产品有119件。截至今年目前为止，该协会称已有创纪录的1,956件产品完成注册。每天都有新产品加入其中。标为纯素的产品包括皮草大衣、塑料制纯素腰带，以及用树皮或天然橡胶制成的鞋子。不过，这些新产品并没有让消费者承担额外费用。纯素靴子的价格与原皮革靴子相同。New Look是最早使用纯素商标的知名连锁店之一，其芭蕾舞鞋售价为7.99英镑，纯素笔记本电脑手提包售价为29.99英镑，与其他产品的价格相当。

lines.en: This signifies a change. In the past, ethical products, whether they were fair trade or organic, came at a premium. However, it is unclear whether these new products can be considered ethical. The debate over durability, crop-growing impacts, pollution and recyclability is a complicated one, not to mention the ethics around the working conditions for people making the products, whatever the component materials. Environmental campaigners advise that the best approach is to buy less, never mind what the item is made of.
lines.zh: 这标志着一种变化。过去，无论是公平贸易产品还是有机产品，伦理类商品的价格都更高。然而，这些新产品是否可以被视为符合伦理标准，尚不明确。关于耐用性、作物种植的影响、污染和可回收性的争论十分复杂，更不用说无论所用材料为何，生产这些产品的工人的工作条件所涉及的伦理问题了。环保人士建议，最好的做法是少买东西，不管商品是由什么制成的。

lines.en: By the end of 2016, anyone who had been paying even passing attention to the news headlines was highly likely to conclude that everything was terrible, and that the world was going to hell. It was easy to feel depressed by the wars in different parts of the world, the spread of deadly viruses or terror attacks.
lines.zh: 到2016年底，任何哪怕只是偶尔关注新闻头条的人，都极有可能得出这样的结论：一切都糟透了，世界正走向毁灭。世界各地的战争、致命病毒的传播或恐怖袭击，很容易让人感到沮丧。

lines.en: Yet, 2016 was the best year in the history of humanity. Child mortality was roughly half what it was as recently as 1990. And 300,000 more people gained access to electricity each day. Every single measure of material and environmental welfare in America, Europe, Asia, Africa and the world as a whole has improved rather than deteriorated. We are living in history's most peaceful era, with violence of all kinds in steep decline. Those are the facts. So why aren't we all optimists?
lines.zh: 然而，2016年却是人类历史上最好的一年。儿童死亡率大约只有就在1990年时的一半。每天还有30万人获得了用电的机会。在美国、欧洲、亚洲、非洲以及全世界范围内，衡量物质和环境福祉的每一项指标都在改善，而不是恶化。我们正生活在人类历史上最和平的时代，各种形式的暴力都在急剧减少。这些都是事实。那么，我们为什么没有全都成为乐观主义者呢？

lines.en: In a 2015 survey for YouGov, 65% of British people and 81% of the French said they thought the world was getting worse. However, according to numerous sensible statistics, these people are simply wrong. Nobody in their right mind should wish to have lived in a previous century. Yet people do. Why?
lines.zh: 在YouGov于2015年进行的一项调查中，65%的英国人和81%的法国人表示，他们认为世界正在变得越来越糟。然而，根据大量合理的统计数据，这些人的看法显然是错误的。任何心智正常的人都不应希望自己生活在过去的某个世纪。然而，人们确实会有这样的愿望。为什么？

lines.en: Our prevailing mood of despair is irrational. It says more about us than it does about how things really are. It is best explained as the result of various psychological biases that served a purpose for our evolutionary ancestors—but now, in a media-saturated era, constantly mislead us. Once upon a time, it was of great survival value to be worried about everything that could go wrong. This is what makes bad news especially compelling.
lines.zh: 我们普遍的绝望情绪是不理性的。它更多地反映了我们自身，而不是事物真实的状况。对这种情绪最好的解释是：它源于各种曾为我们进化时期的祖先发挥过作用的心理偏差，但如今在媒体充斥的时代，这些心理偏差却不断误导我们。曾几何时，对所有可能出错的事情保持担忧具有极大的生存价值。正因如此，坏消息尤其引人关注。

lines.en: In our evolutionary past, it was a very good thing that our attention could be easily seized by negative information, since it might well indicate a dangerous risk to our own survival. The caveman who always assumed there was a lion behind the next rock would usually be wrong, but he'd be much more likely to survive and reproduce than one who always assumed the opposite. But that was all before newspapers, television and the internet. In today's hyper connected times, our addiction to bad news just leads us to vacuum up depressing or enraging stories from across the globe. Whether these news stories threaten us or not, we conclude that things are much worse than they actually are. Really good news, on the other hand, can be a lot harder to spot in a newspaper because predictable daily events by definition aren't news.
lines.zh: 在我们的进化史中，我们的注意力很容易被负面信息吸引是一件非常有益的事，因为这些信息很可能意味着对自身生存构成的危险。那个总是假定下一块岩石后面有一头狮子的穴居人通常会判断错误，但与总是假定情况相反的人相比，他存活并繁衍后代的可能性要大得多。但那是在报纸、电视和互联网出现以前。如今，在这个高度互联的时代，我们对坏消息的沉迷只会让我们从全球各地吸纳令人沮丧或愤怒的故事。无论这些新闻是否真的对我们构成威胁，我们都会得出这样的结论：事情比实际情况糟糕得多。另一方面，真正的好消息在报纸上往往更难被发现，因为可预见的日常事件按定义来说并不算新闻。

passages.en: Our brains respond to language expressing facts differently than they do to words conveying possibility, scientists at New York University have recently found. Their work offers new insights into the impact word choice has on how we __(26)__ between statements expressing what is real versus what is merely possible. The researchers assert their findings are important because we are presented with false information all the time. Some of this is __(27)__ , as is the case with deceptive advertisements, but the problem is __(28)__ by individuals who believe they are sharing correct information. Thus, it is more important than ever to separate the factual from the possible or merely __(29)__ in how we communicate. This is especially true as the study makes clear that information presented as fact __(30)__ special responses in our brains, which are distinct from when we process the same content with clear indicators of __(31)__ .
passages.zh: 纽约大学的科学家最近发现，与表达可能性的词语相比，我们的大脑对表达事实的语言会产生不同的反应。他们的研究为词语选择如何影响我们区分表达真实情况与仅仅表达可能性的陈述，提供了新的见解。研究人员认为，他们的发现十分重要，因为我们一直在接触虚假信息。其中一些是故意制造的，例如欺骗性广告中的虚假信息；但那些自以为是在分享正确信息的人，也使这一问题更加严重。因此，在我们的交流方式中，将事实与可能性或仅仅是推测区分开来，比以往任何时候都更加重要。研究清楚表明，这一点尤其如此：以事实形式呈现的信息会引发我们大脑的特殊反应，而当我们处理带有明确不确定性标志的相同内容时，大脑的反应则有所不同。

passages.en: In their new study, the scientists intended to __(32)__ how the brain computes possibilities as expressed by words such as "may," "might," and "if." The researchers compared brain responses to statements expressing factual __(33)__ and those expressing possibility. "There is a monster under my bed" exemplifies a factual statement. "I will stay home," is also factual. This is opposed to statements that express possibility, like "There might be a monster under my bed," or "If it rains, I will stay home." The results of the study showed that factual language __(34)__ a rapid increase in brain activity, with the brain responding more powerfully and showing more engagement with factual phrases compared to those communicating possibility. Thus, facts rule when it comes to the brain. Brain regions involved in processing __(35)__ rapidly distinguish facts from possibilities. Further, these regions respond in a much more robust fashion to factual statements.
passages.zh: 在这项新研究中，科学家旨在确定大脑如何计算由“may”“might”和“if”等词语表达的可能性。研究人员比较了大脑对表达事实情境的陈述和表达可能性的陈述所产生的反应。“我的床底下有一个怪物”是事实陈述的例子。“我会待在家里”同样是事实陈述。这与表达可能性的陈述不同，例如“我的床底下可能有一个怪物”或“如果下雨，我就待在家里”。研究结果显示，事实性语言会使大脑活动迅速增强；与传达可能性的短语相比，大脑对事实性短语的反应更强烈，参与程度也更高。因此，就大脑而言，事实占据主导地位。参与话语处理的大脑区域能够迅速区分事实与可能性。此外，这些区域对事实陈述的反应也强烈得多。

longreading.title: 2023年12月·第2套 英语六级长篇阅读（信息匹配） 第 1 篇 · 36–45 题答案与解析

passages.en: A) Most visitors come to Cape Canaveral, on the northeast coast of Florida, for the tourist attractions. It's home to the second-busiest cruise ship port in the world and is a gateway to the cosmos. Nearly 1.5 million visitors flock here every year to watch rockets, spacecraft, and satellites blast off into the solar system from Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex. Nearly 64 kilometers of undeveloped beach and 648 square kilometers of protected refuge fan out from the cape's sandy shores.
passages.zh: 大多数游客来到佛罗里达州东北海岸的卡纳维拉尔角，是为了参观旅游景点。这里拥有世界上第二繁忙的邮轮港，也是通往宇宙的门户。每年将近150万名游客蜂拥至肯尼迪航天中心游客综合体，观看火箭、航天器和卫星从这里升空，飞入太阳系。近64千米未开发的海滩和648平方千米的受保护自然保护区，从海角的沙岸向四面展开。

passages.en: B) Yet some of Cape Canaveral's most legendary attractions lie unseen, wedged under the sea's surface in mud and sand, for this part of the world has a reputation as a deadly ship trap. Over the centuries, dozens of majestic Old World sailing ships smashed and sank on this irregular stretch of windy Florida coast. They were vessels built for war and commerce, crossing the globe carrying everything from coins to cannons, boxes of silver and gold, chests of jewels and porcelain, and pearls from the Caribbean.
passages.zh: 然而，卡纳维拉尔角一些最具传奇色彩的景点却隐藏在海面下，深埋于泥沙之中，因为世界上的这一地区素有致命“沉船陷阱”之称。几个世纪以来，数十艘雄伟的旧世界帆船在佛罗里达这段曲折多风的海岸上撞毁并沉没。它们是为战争和商业而建造的船只，横渡全球，载运的货物从钱币到大炮，从一箱箱的银和金到一箱箱的珠宝与瓷器，以及来自加勒比海的珍珠，无所不包。

passages.en: C) Cape Canaveral contains one of the greatest concentrations of colonial shipwrecks in the world. In recent years, advances in radar, diving, detection equipment, computers, and GPS have transformed the hunt. The naked eye might see a pile of rocks, but technology can reveal the precious artifacts(人工制品) that lie hidden on the ocean floor.
passages.zh: 卡纳维拉尔角拥有世界上殖民时期沉船最集中的区域之一。近年来，雷达、潜水、探测设备、计算机和GPS技术的进步改变了搜寻方式。肉眼或许只能看到一堆岩石，但技术能够揭示隐藏在海底的珍贵人工制品。

passages.en: D) As technology renders the seabed more accessible, the hunt for treasure-filled ships has drawn a fresh tide of salvors(打捞人员) and their investors—as well as marine archaeologists(考古学家) wanting to bring to light the lost relics. But of late, when salvors have found vessels, their rights have been challenged in court. The big question: who should have control of these treasures?
passages.zh: 随着技术使海床变得更加容易探查，寻找满载宝藏船只的行动吸引了新一批打捞人员及其投资者，也吸引了希望揭示失落遗物的海洋考古学家。然而，近来打捞人员发现船只后，他们的权利却在法庭上受到挑战。关键问题是：谁应当拥有对这些宝藏的控制权？

passages.en: E) High-stakes fights over shipwrecks pit archaeologists against treasure hunters in a vicious cycle of accusations. Archaeologists regard themselves as protectors of history, and they see salvors as careless destroyers. Salvors feel they do the hard work of searching for ships, only to have them stolen from under them when discovered. This kind of clash inevitably takes place on a grand scale. Aside from the salvors, their investors, and the maritime archaeologists who serve as expert witnesses, the battles sweep in local and international governments and organizations like UNESCO that work to protect under-water heritage. The court cases that ensue stretch on for years. Are finders keepers, or do the ships belong to the countries that made them and sent them sailing centuries ago? Where once salvors and archaeologists worked side by side, now they belong to opposing, and equally contemptuous, tribes.
passages.zh: 围绕沉船展开的高风险争斗，使考古学家与寻宝者在相互指责的恶性循环中对立起来。考古学家把自己视为历史的保护者，而将打捞人员看作粗心大意的破坏者。打捞人员则觉得，寻找船只的艰苦工作由他们完成，可一旦发现船只，它们就被人从他们手中夺走。这种冲突不可避免地会大规模发生。除打捞人员、他们的投资者以及作为专家证人出庭的海事考古学家外，地方和国际政府，以及联合国教科文组织等致力于保护水下遗产的组织，也都被卷入这些争端。随之而来的诉讼往往持续数年。发现者是否拥有所有权，还是这些船只属于几百年前建造它们并派它们出海的国家？曾经并肩工作的打捞人员和考古学家，如今却成了彼此对立、同样轻蔑对方的两个群体。

passages.en: F) Nearly three million vessels lie wrecked on the Earth's ocean floor—from old canoes to the Titanic—and likely less than one percent have been explored. Some—like an ancient Roman ship found off Antikythera, Greece, dated between 70 and 60 BC and carrying astonishingly sophisticated gears and dials for navigating by the sun—are critical to a new understanding of our past. No wonder there is an eternal stirring among everybody from salvors to scholars to find them.
passages.zh: 从古老的独木舟到“泰坦尼克号”，地球海底躺着近300万艘沉船，而其中很可能只有不到百分之一得到过探查。有些沉船对于重新认识我们的过去至关重要，例如在希腊安提凯希拉岛附近发现的一艘古罗马船只，其年代可追溯至公元前70年至公元前60年之间，船上载有极其精密的齿轮和刻度盘，可借助太阳辨别航向。难怪从打捞人员到学者，所有人心中都始终怀着寻找它们的冲动。

passages.en: G) In May 2016, a salvor named Bobby Pritchett, president of Global Marine Exploration (GME) in Tampa, Florida, announced that he had discovered scattered remains of a ship buried a kilometer off Cape Canaveral. Over the prior three years, he and his crew had obtained 14 state permits to survey a nearly 260-square-kilometer area off the cape; they worked 250 days a year, backed by investor funds of, he claims, US $4 million. It was hard work. Crew members were up at dawn, dragging sensors from their expedition vessels back and forth, day in and day out, year after year, to detect metal of any kind. Using computer technology, Pritchett and his crew created intricate, color-coded maps marked with the GPS coordinates of thousands of finds, all invisible under a meter of sand.
passages.zh: 2016年5月，佛罗里达州坦帕市Global Marine Exploration（GME）公司的总裁、打捞人员Bobby Pritchett宣布，他发现了卡纳维拉尔角附近一艘埋在海底、距离海岸一千米的船只的零散残骸。在此前三年中，他和他的团队获得了14份州政府许可，用于勘查海角附近一片面积近260平方千米的海域；他们每年工作250天，资金由投资者提供，据他声称达400万美元。这是一项艰苦的工作。队员们每天黎明即起，日复一日、年复一年地拖着传感器，让探险船在海上来回航行，以探测任何种类的金属。利用计算机技术，Pritchett和他的团队绘制出了复杂的彩色编码地图，标注着数千件发现物的GPS坐标，而这些物品全都隐藏在一米深的沙层之下，肉眼无法看见。

passages.en: H) One day in 2015, the magnetometer(磁力计) picked up metal that turned out to be an iron cannon; when the divers blew the sand away, they also discovered a more precious bronze cannon with markings indicating French royalty and, not far off, a famous marble column carved with the coat of arms of France, known from historical paintings. The discovery was cause for celebration. The artifacts indicated the divers had likely found the wreck of La Trinité, a 16th-century French vessel that had been at the center of a bloody battle between France and Spain that changed the fate of the United States of America.
passages.zh: 2015年的一天，磁力计探测到一块金属，后来证实是一门铁炮；潜水员吹走沙子后，还发现了一门更为珍贵的青铜炮，上面的标记显示它属于法国王室。不远处，他们又发现了一根著名的大理石柱，柱身上刻有法国国徽，这一图案可从历史画作中得到确认。这一发现足以令人庆祝。这些文物表明，潜水员很可能找到了“拉特里尼泰号”的沉船遗址。这是一艘16世纪的法国船只，曾处于法国与西班牙之间一场血腥战役的中心，而那场战役改变了美利坚合众国的命运。

passages.en: I) And then the legal storm began, with GME and Pritchett pitted against Florida and France. The Sunken Military Craft Act of 2004, a US federal act, protects any vessel that was on a military mission, allowing the originating country to claim their ship even centuries later. In 2018, two long years after Pritchett's discovery, the federal district court ruled in favor of France. For Pritchett, the decision was devastating. Millions of dollars of investor funding and years of labor were lost.
passages.zh: 随后，法律风暴开始了，GME和Pritchett与佛罗里达州及法国对簿公堂。美国联邦政府制定的《2004年沉没军用船只法》保护任何执行过军事任务的船只，允许其所属国即使在几个世纪后仍然提出对该船的所有权主张。2018年，也就是Pritchett发现沉船整整两年后，联邦地区法院作出裁决，判法国胜诉。对Pritchett而言，这一裁决是毁灭性的。数百万美元的投资者资金和多年的劳动都付诸东流。

passages.en: J) But this is far from the first time a salvor has lost all rights to a discovery. In 2012, for instance, Spain won a five-year legal battle against Odyssey Marine Exploration, which had hauled 594,000 gold and silver coins from a Spanish wreck off the coast of Portugal across the Atlantic to the United States. "Treasure hunters can be naive," says attorney David Concannon, who has had several maritime archaeologists as clients and represented two sides in the battles over the Titanic for 20 years. "Many treasure hunters don't understand they are going to have to fight for their rights against a government that has an endless supply of money for legal battles that treasure hunters are likely to lose."
passages.zh: 但这远不是打捞人员失去对一项发现的全部权利的第一例。比如，2012年，西班牙赢得了与Odyssey Marine Exploration长达五年的法律斗争。Odyssey Marine Exploration曾从葡萄牙近海的一艘西班牙沉船中打捞出594,000枚金银币，并将它们跨越大西洋运到美国。曾代理过几位海洋考古学家，并在围绕“泰坦尼克号”的争端中代表双方各自打了20年官司的律师David Concannon说：“寻宝者可能过于天真。许多寻宝者不明白，他们将不得不为自己的权利与一个政府抗争，而政府拥有源源不断的资金，可以用来进行寻宝者很可能会输掉的法律斗争。”

passages.en: K) Putting an inflated price on artifacts rather than viewing them as cultural and historical treasures that transcend any price is what irritates many archaeologists. For the archaeologist, everything in a wreck matters—hair, fabric, a fragment of a newspaper, rat bones-all things speak volumes. Archaeologists don't want artifacts ending up in a private collection instead of taking humanity on a journey of understanding.
passages.zh: 令许多考古学家恼火的是，人们给文物标上过高的价格，而不是把它们视为超越任何价格的文化和历史瑰宝。对考古学家来说，沉船中的一切都很重要——头发、织物、报纸碎片、老鼠骨头——所有这些东西都能提供大量信息。考古学家不希望文物最终落入私人收藏，而不愿让人类踏上探索和理解的旅程。

passages.en: L) George Bass is one of the pioneers of under-water archaeology, and a researcher at Texas A&M University. He has testified in court against treasure hunters, but says archaeology is not without its own serious problems. He believes archaeologists need to do a better job themselves instead of routinely criticizing treasure hunters. "Archaeology has a terrible reputation for not publishing enough on its excavations(发掘) and finds," he says. Gathering data, unearthing and meticulously preserving and examining finds, verifying identity and origin, piecing together the larger story, and writing and publishing a comprehensive paper or book can take decades. A bit cynically, Bass describes colleagues who never published because they waited so long they became ill or died. Who is more at fault, Bass asks, the professional archaeologist who carefully excavates a site and never publishes on it or the treasure hunter who locates a submerged wreck, salvages part, conserves part, and publishes a book on the operation?
passages.zh: George Bass是水下考古学的先驱之一，也是德州农工大学的研究人员。他曾在法庭上作证反对寻宝者，但他说，考古学自身也存在严重问题。他认为，考古学家不应一贯批评寻宝者，而需要先把自己的工作做得更好。“考古学因没有充分发表有关发掘和发现成果的论文而声名狼藉，”他说。收集数据、发掘并细致地保存和检验发现物、核实其身份和来源、拼凑出更大的故事，以及撰写并发表一篇全面的论文或一本专著，可能需要几十年。Bass带着几分讥讽地描述了一些同事：他们迟迟不发表成果，最后病倒或去世了。Bass问道：究竟是谁的过错更大，是那位认真发掘一个遗址却从未发表相关成果的专业考古学家，还是那位找到一艘水下沉船、打捞其中一部分、保存其中一部分，并将整个行动写成书出版的寻宝者？

passages.en: M) Pritchett concedes that his find deserves careful excavation and preservation. "I think what I found should go in a museum," he says. "But I also think I should get paid for what I found." Indeed, it's a bit of a mystery why governments, archaeologists, and treasure hunters can't work together—and why salvors aren't at least given a substantial finder's fee before the original owner takes possession of the vessel and its artifacts.
passages.zh: Pritchett承认，他的发现值得得到细致的发掘和保存。“我认为我的发现应该被送进博物馆，”他说。“但我也认为，我应该因自己的发现获得报酬。”的确，令人有些不解的是，政府、考古学家和寻宝者为什么不能合作，以及为什么在原所有者接管船只及其文物之前，不能至少先向打捞人员支付一笔可观的发现者酬金。

For the archaeologist, everything in a wreck matters—hair, fabric, a fragment of a newspaper, rat bones-all things speak volumes. Archaeologists don't want artifacts ending up in a private collection instead of taking humanity on a journey of understanding. 把文物标上虚高的价格，而不是把它们看作超越任何价格的文化与历史财富，是令许多考古学家恼火的事。对考古学家来说，沉船里的一切都意义重大——头发、织物、报纸残片、老鼠骨——一切都饱含信息。考古学家不愿文物落入私人收藏，而非带领人类踏上一段理解之旅。

passages.en: Could you get by without using the internet for four and a half years? That's exactly what singer and actress Selena Gomez has done in a bid to improve her mental health.
passages.zh: 你能在四年半的时间里不使用互联网而生活下去吗？这正是歌手兼演员赛琳娜·戈麦斯为了改善自己的心理健康所做的事情。

passages.en: She has spoken extensively about the relationship between her social media usage and her mental wellbeing, recalling feeling like "an addict" when she became Instagram's most followed user in 2016. "Taking a break from social media was the best decision that I've ever made for my mental health", says she. "The unnecessary hate and comparisons went away once I put my phone down."
passages.zh: 她曾多次谈到使用社交媒体与心理健康之间的关系，并回忆说，2016年成为Instagram上粉丝最多的用户时，她感觉自己像“上瘾者”一样。“暂时离开社交媒体是我为心理健康所做过的最好的决定，”她说，“放下手机后，那些不必要的仇恨和攀比都消失了。”

passages.en: Ditching the web at large, however, is a far more subtle and complicated prospect. The increasing digitisation of our society means that everything from paying a gas bill to plotting a route to a friend's house and even making a phone call is at the mercy of your internet connection. Actively opting out of using the internet becomes a matter of privilege.
passages.zh: 然而，彻底放弃互联网则是一个微妙得多、复杂得多的选择。社会日益数字化意味着，从支付燃气费、规划去朋友家的路线，甚至到拨打电话，一切都要受互联网连接的制约。主动选择不使用互联网，变成了一种只有有条件的人才能享有的特权。

passages.en: Ms Gomez's multi-millionaire status has allowed her to take the "social" out of social media, so she can continue to leverage her enormous fame while keeping the trolls(恶意挑衅的帖子) at bay. The fact that she's still the second most-followed woman on Instagram suggests it's entirely possible to maintain a significant web profile to promote various projects—by way of a dedicated team—without being exposed to the cruel comments, hate mail and rape or death threats.
passages.zh: 戈麦斯女士数百万富翁的身份使她能够从社交媒体中去掉“社交”这一部分，因此她可以继续利用自己巨大的名气，同时把恶意挑衅的帖子拒之门外。她仍然是Instagram上粉丝数量第二多的女性，这一事实表明，通过一个专门的团队来运营，完全有可能在维持重要网络形象、推广各种项目的同时，不接触残酷的评论、仇恨邮件以及强奸或死亡威胁。

passages.en: It goes without saying that this is fundamentally different from how the rest of us without beauty deals and films to publicise use the likes of Instagram, TikTok and Twitter, but even the concept of a digital detox(戒瘾) requires having a device and connectivity to choose to disconnect from.
passages.zh: 不言而喻，这与我们这些没有美容产品代言和电影需要宣传的人使用Instagram、TikTok和Twitter的方式有着根本区别，但即使是“数字戒毒”这一概念，也要求人们先拥有可以选择断开连接的设备和网络。

passages.en: The UK's digital divide has worsened over the past two years, leaving poorer families without broadband connections in their homes. Digital exclusion is a major threat to wider societal equality in the UK, so witnessing companies like Facebook championing the metaverse(元宇宙) as the next great frontier when school children are struggling to complete their homework feels particularly irritating.
passages.zh: 过去两年，英国的数字鸿沟进一步恶化，使得一些较贫困的家庭家中没有宽带连接。数字排斥是对英国更广泛的社会平等构成的重大威胁，因此，当学龄儿童还在为完成家庭作业而苦苦挣扎时，看到Facebook这样的公司把元宇宙吹捧为下一个伟大前沿，尤其令人恼火。

passages.en: Consequently, it's worth bearing in mind that while deleting all social media accounts will undoubtedly make some feel infinitely better, many other people benefit from the strong sense of community that sharing platforms can breed.
passages.zh: 因此，值得牢记的是，虽然删除所有社交媒体账户无疑会让一些人感觉好得多，但许多其他人则受益于分享平台能够培育的强烈社区感。

passages.en: Internet access will continue to grow in importance as we edge further towards web 3.0, and greater resources and initiatives are needed to provide the underprivileged with the connectivity they desperately need to learn, work and live. It's crucial that people who feel that social media is having a detrimental effect on their mental health are allowed to switch off and for those living in digital exclusion to be able to switch on in the first place.
passages.zh: 随着我们进一步迈向Web 3.0，互联网接入的重要性将继续提高，因此需要更多资源和举措，为那些处境不利的人提供他们迫切需要的网络连接，以便学习、工作和生活。必须让那些认为社交媒体正在对其心理健康产生不利影响的人能够关掉网络，也必须让那些遭受数字排斥的人首先有能力接入网络。

questions.判型: What do we learn about singer and actress Selena Gomez in the past four and a half years? 指向「她过去四年半发生了什么」这一具体事实，没有 infer/imply/mainly。

questions.定位: P2 Taking a break from social media was the best decision that I've ever made for my mental health 远离社交媒体是我为心理健康做过的最好的决定。

locate.en: Taking a break from social media was the best decision that I've ever made for my mental health

option_analysis.note: 原文说她远离社媒是为改善心理健康（the best decision that I've ever made for my mental health），而 She has had worsening mental problems 把「为改善心理健康」反过来说成「心理问题加重」，与原文方向相反。

pairs.orig: Taking a break from social media was the best decision that I've ever made for my mental health

questions.stem: Why does actively opting out of using the internet become a matter of privilege?
questions.stem_zh: 为什么主动选择不使用互联网成为一种特权问题?

options.text: Most people find it subtle and complicated to give up using the internet.
options.zh: 大多数人发现放弃使用互联网既微妙又复杂。

options.text: Most people can hardly ditch the web while avoiding hate and comparisons.
options.zh: 大多数人在避免仇恨和比较的同时很难摆脱网络。

options.text: Most people can hardly get by without the internet due to growing digitisation.
options.zh: 由于数字化程度不断提高,大多数人没有互联网几乎无法生活。

options.text: Most people have been seriously addicted to the web without being aware of it.
options.zh: 大多数人在不知不觉中已经严重沉迷于网络。

questions.判型: Why does actively opting out of using the internet become a matter of privilege? 已把结论摆出，要在原文找直接给出的原因，属于原因型细节题。
questions.拆句: Why does actively opting out of using the internet become a matter of privilege? 主干 does opting out become a matter of privilege；动名词短语 actively opting out of using the internet 作主语；a matter of privilege 是表语。Why 直接问原因。
questions.定位: P3 The increasing digitisation of our society means that everything from paying a gas bill to plotting a route to a friend's house and even making a phone call is at the mercy of your internet connection. Actively opting out of using the internet becomes a matter of privilege. 我们社会日益数字化意味着——从交一笔煤气费、规划一条去朋友家的路线，甚至打一通电话——一切都受制于你的网络连接。主动选择不使用互联网由此变成一种特权。

locate.en: The increasing digitisation of our society means that everything from paying a gas bill to plotting a route to a friend's house and even making a phone call is at the mercy of your internet connection. Actively opting out of using the internet becomes a matter of privilege.
locate.zh: 我们社会日益数字化意味着——从交一笔煤气费、规划一条去朋友家的路线，甚至打一通电话——一切都受制于你的网络连接。主动选择不使用互联网由此变成一种特权。

option_analysis.note: Most people find it subtle and complicated to give up using the internet 改写自 Ditching the web at large, however, is a far more subtle and complicated prospect，描述的是「难度」，并未回答题干「为何成为特权」。

Most people can hardly ditch the web while avoiding hate and comparisons 把「避开仇恨与攀比」塞给「为何不上网是特权」这一问题；但 The unnecessary hate and comparisons went away once I put my phone down 讲的是 Gomez 远离社媒后的结果，与 Q47 的因果无关。
预判的因果（数字化 → 离不开网 → 不上网成特权）与 Most people can hardly get by without the internet due to growing digitisation 一一对应。

pairs.opt: Most people can hardly get by without the internet due to growing digitisation

options.text: The concept of the metaverse is believed to be still quite illusory.

questions.定位: P6 The UK's digital divide has worsened over the past two years, leaving poorer families without broadband connections in their homes. Digital exclusion is a major threat to wider societal equality in the UK, so witnessing companies like Facebook championing the metaverse(元宇宙) as the next great frontier when school children are struggling to complete their homework feels particularly irritating. 英国的数字鸿沟在过去两年里加剧，导致较贫困家庭家中没有宽带。数字排斥是英国社会整体公平的一大威胁，因此当学童正为完成作业犯难时，看到 Facebook 之类的公司还在把元宇宙鼓吹成下一个伟大前沿，就让人尤其感到刺目。

Digital exclusion is a major threat to wider societal equality in the UK, so witnessing companies like Facebook championing the metaverse(元宇宙) as the next great frontier when school children are struggling to complete their homework feels particularly irritating.
locate.zh: 英国的数字鸿沟在过去两年里加剧，导致较贫困家庭家中没有宽带。数字排斥是英国社会整体公平的一大威胁，因此当学童正为完成作业犯难时，看到 Facebook 之类的公司还在把元宇宙鼓吹成下一个伟大前沿，就让人尤其感到刺目。

option_analysis.note: 预判「鼓吹元宇宙会加深数字鸿沟」与 The UK digital divide would further worsen due to the metaverse 完全对应，且推断只走一步，未越界。

pairs.orig: The UK's digital divide has worsened over the past two years
pairs.opt: The UK digital divide would further worsen due to the metaverse

pairs.orig: championing the metaverse(元宇宙) as the next great frontier when school children are struggling to complete their homework

option_analysis.note: The concept of the metaverse is believed to be still quite illusory 评价的是「元宇宙是否虚幻」，原文只用 the next great frontier 描述公司的宣传口径，并未对 metaverse 概念本身的「虚幻与否」作判断。
School children would be drawn farther away from the real world 把焦点放在「学童被拉离现实世界」，但原文中学童的位置是 struggling to complete their homework——他们是因为没有宽带连作业都做不了，而不是被元宇宙拉离现实。

Most families in the UK do not have stable broadband connections 把原文 leaving poorer families without broadband connections in their homes 的「较贫困家庭」扩大为「大多数家庭」；同时这只是引发 irritating 的背景之一，而不是作者觉得 irritating 的核心原因。

questions.stem: What is worth bearing in mind concerning social media platforms?
questions.stem_zh: 关于社交媒体平台,什么值得牢记?

options.text: They are conducive to promoting societal equality.

questions.判型: What is worth bearing in mind concerning social media platforms? 问的是作者明确提示要记住的事实，对应原文一处明确陈述。
questions.拆句: What is worth bearing in mind concerning social media platforms? 主干 What is worth bearing in mind；动名词短语 bearing in mind 作 worth 的宾语；介词短语 concerning social media platforms 限定话题。结构清晰无陷阱。
questions.定位: P7 Consequently, it's worth bearing in mind that while deleting all social media accounts will undoubtedly make some feel infinitely better, many other people benefit from the strong sense of community that sharing platforms can breed. 因此，值得记住的是：虽然删除所有社交媒体账号无疑会让一些人感觉好得多，但许多其他人则从共享平台所孕育的强烈社群感中获益。

locate.en: Consequently, it's worth bearing in mind that while deleting all social media accounts will undoubtedly make some feel infinitely better, many other people benefit from the strong sense of community that sharing platforms can breed.
locate.zh: 因此，值得记住的是：虽然删除所有社交媒体账号无疑会让一些人感觉好得多，但许多其他人则从共享平台所孕育的强烈社群感中获益。

option_analysis.note: They are conducive to promoting societal equality 借用了上一段 wider societal equality in the UK 的高敏感词 societal equality，但原文是说「数字排斥威胁公平」，并未说社交媒体平台「促进」公平。
预判的「连接感」和 They help many people feel connected with others 完美对应，且 They 指代 social media platforms / sharing platforms。

pairs.orig: many other people benefit from the strong sense of community that sharing platforms can breed
pairs.opt: They help many people feel connected with others

option_analysis.note: They provide a necessary device for a digital detox 颠倒了原文逻辑：even the concept of a digital detox(戒瘾) requires having a device and connectivity to choose to disconnect from 说的是「做数字戒瘾本身就要先有设备和网络」，设备/网络是 digital detox 的前提，而非由社交媒体平台提供。
They create a virtual community on the internet 用 virtual community 偷换原文的 strong sense of community。原文强调的是「社群归属感」（用户主观感受），而 virtual community 指「线上社群」这一实体，重点偏离；并且原文用 breed（孕育）描述的是「感受」被催生，而非「社群」被创造。

questions.stem: What does the author think is really important for those living in digital exclusion?
questions.stem_zh: 作者认为对于生活在数字排斥中的人们来说,什么才是真正重要的?

options.text: Having access to the internet.

options.text: Edging further towards web 3.0.

questions.判型: What does the author think is really important for those living in digital exclusion? 问作者明示的观点，且原文有 crucial 一句直接对应，归为细节题。
questions.拆句: What does the author think is really important for those living in digital exclusion? What 作 think 后宾语从句的主语；is really important 是表语；介词短语 for those living in digital exclusion 限定对象，其中 living in digital exclusion 是现在分词短语作后置定语修饰 those。
questions.定位: P8 It's crucial that people who feel that social media is having a detrimental effect on their mental health are allowed to switch off and for those living in digital exclusion to be able to switch on in the first place. 至关重要的是：让那些觉得社交媒体正在损害自己心理健康的人能够「关掉」，也要让那些深陷数字排斥的人首先能够「打开」。

locate.zh: 至关重要的是：让那些觉得社交媒体正在损害自己心理健康的人能够「关掉」，也要让那些深陷数字排斥的人首先能够「打开」。

option_analysis.note: 预判「先能联网」与 Having access to the internet 完全对应，且与同段两处描述都能挂上。

pairs.orig: for those living in digital exclusion to be able to switch on in the first place
greater resources and initiatives are needed to provide the underprivileged with the connectivity they desperately need

option_analysis.note: Edging further towards web 3.0 改自 Internet access will continue to grow in importance as we edge further towards web 3.0，但 edge further towards web 3.0 在原文是描述时代背景，而非「对数字排斥者真正重要的事」。

Getting more educational resources 把原文 greater resources and initiatives are needed to provide the underprivileged with the connectivity they desperately need to learn, work and live 中的 resources 缩到「教育资源」。原文 resources 指的是「用于提供网络连接的资源」，learn 只是 connectivity 的用途之一。
Opening more social media accounts 与全文论调（提醒社媒对心理健康有害、Gomez 主动远离社媒）相反；原文要那些 digital exclusion 的人 switch on 的是「网络连接」，并非「更多社媒账号」。

reading2.title: 2023年12月·第2套 英语六级阅读理解（四选一） 第 2 篇 · 51–55 题答案与解析

passages.en: Psychologists have long been in disagreement as to whether competition is a learned or a genetic component of human behavior. Whatever it is, you cannot but recognize the effect competition is exerting in academics and many other areas of contemporary life.
passages.zh: 长期以来，心理学家一直未能就竞争究竟是人类行为中后天习得的成分还是遗传的成分达成一致。无论它究竟属于哪一种，你都不得不承认，竞争正在对学术以及当代生活的许多其他领域产生影响。

passages.en: Psychologically speaking, competition has been seen as an inevitable consequence of human drives. According to Sigmund Freud, humans are born screaming for attention and full of organic drives for fulfillment in various areas. Initially, we compete for the attention of our parents. Thereafter, we are at the mercy of a battle between our base impulses for self-fulfillment and social and cultural norms which prohibit pure indulgence.
passages.zh: 从心理学角度来说，竞争一直被视为人类各种欲望不可避免的结果。按照西格蒙德·弗洛伊德的观点，人一出生就会通过哭喊来寻求关注，并且在各个方面都充满了要求得到满足的生理欲望。起初，我们会为获得父母的关注而竞争。此后，我们便受到一场斗争的支配：一方是要求自我满足的基本冲动，另一方则是禁止纯粹放纵的社会和文化规范。

passages.en: Current work in anthropology(人类学) has suggested, however, that this view of the role of competition in human behavior may be incorrect. Thomas Hobbes, one of the great philosophers of the seventeenth century, is perhaps best remembered for his characterization of the "natural world," that is, the world before the imposition of the will of humanity, as being "nasty, brutish, and short." This image of the pre-rational world is still widely held, reinforced by Charles Darwin's highly influential work, The Origin of Species, which established the doctrine of natural selection. This doctrine, which takes for granted that those species best able to adapt to and master the natural environment in which they live will survive, has suggested that the struggle for survival is an inherent human trait which determines a person's success. Darwin's theory has even been summarized as "survival of the fittest"—a phrase Darwin himself never used—further highlighting competition's role in success. As it has often been pointed out, however, there is nothing in the concept of natural selection that suggests that competition is the most successful strategy for "survival of the fittest." Darwin asserted in The Origin of Species that the struggles he was describing should be viewed as metaphors and could easily include dependence and cooperation.
passages.zh: 然而，人类学目前的研究表明，这种关于竞争在人类行为中所起作用的看法可能是不正确的。托马斯·霍布斯是十七世纪伟大的哲学家之一，人们或许最熟悉的是他对“自然世界”的描述，即在人类意志介入之前的世界，是“肮脏、野蛮而短暂的”。这种关于理性出现之前的世界的形象至今仍被广泛接受，而查尔斯·达尔文极具影响力的著作《物种起源》提出了自然选择学说，更加巩固了这一看法。该学说想当然地认为，那些最能适应并驾驭其所处自然环境的物种将会生存下来；这使人们认为，生存斗争是人类固有的特征，并决定着一个人的成功。达尔文的理论甚至被概括为“适者生存”——尽管达尔文本人从未使用过这一说法——从而进一步突出了竞争在成功中的作用。然而，正如人们经常指出的那样，自然选择这一概念中并没有任何内容表明，竞争是“适者生存”最为成功的策略。达尔文在《物种起源》中断言，他所描述的斗争应被视为隐喻，其中完全可以包括依赖与合作。

passages.en: Many studies have been conducted to test the importance placed on competition as opposed to other values, such as cooperation—by various cultures, and generally conclude that Americans uniquely praise competition as natural, inevitable, and desirable. In 1937, the world-renowned anthropologist Margaret Mead published Cooperation and Competition among Primitive Peoples, based on her studies of several societies that did not prize competition, and, in fact, seemed at times to place a negative value on it. One such society was the Zuni Indians of Arizona, and they, Mead found, valued cooperation far more than competition. After studying dozens of such cultures, Mead's final conclusion was that competitiveness is a culturally created aspect of human behavior, and that its prevalence in a particular society is relative to how that society values it.
passages.zh: 人们开展了许多研究，以检验各种文化对竞争相对于合作等其他价值观的重视程度；这些研究通常得出结论：美国人独特地将竞争称赞为自然的、不可避免的和令人向往的。1937年，世界著名人类学家玛格丽特·米德根据对几个并不推崇竞争、事实上有时似乎还对竞争持负面评价的社会的研究，出版了《原始民族中的合作与竞争》一书。亚利桑那州的祖尼印第安人便是其中一个这样的社会。米德发现，他们对合作的重视远远超过对竞争的重视。在研究了几十个这样的文化之后，米德最终得出结论：竞争性是人类行为中由文化创造出来的一个方面，而它在某一特定社会中的普遍程度，取决于该社会对它的重视程度。

questions.stem: What does the author think is easy to see in many areas of contemporary life?
questions.stem_zh: 作者认为在当代生活的许多领域中什么是容易看到的?

options.text: The disagreement on the inevitability of competition.
options.zh: 对竞争不可避免性的分歧。

options.text: The consequence of psychological investigation.
options.zh: 心理学研究的后果。

options.text: The effect of human drives.
options.zh: 人类驱动力的影响。

options.text: The impact of competition.
options.zh: 竞争的影响。

questions.判型: 题干What does the author think is easy to see in many areas of contemporary life?问的是作者在"当代生活的许多领域"中明确认为容易见到的东西，属于对原文某一具体表述的复述题，没有 infer/imply/mainly about 等推断或主旨信号。
questions.拆句: Q51主干是 What ... is easy to see；the author think 是插入的宾语从句性插入语，问的实际是 What is easy to see；in many areas of contemporary life 是地点状语，限定范围。句式平铺，无陷阱。
questions.定位: P1 Whatever it is, you cannot but recognize the effect competition is exerting in academics and many other areas of contemporary life. 不管竞争是什么（天生还是习得），你都不得不承认竞争正在学术界以及当代生活的许多其他领域中所产生的影响。

locate.en: Whatever it is, you cannot but recognize the effect competition is exerting in academics and many other areas of contemporary life.
locate.zh: 不管竞争是什么（天生还是习得），你都不得不承认竞争正在学术界以及当代生活的许多其他领域中所产生的影响。

option_analysis.note: The disagreement on the inevitability of competition.借的是Psychologists have long been in disagreement as to whether competition is a learned or a genetic component of human behavior这一句，但原文说"心理学家一直有分歧"，而题干问的是"你不得不看到"的东西，把分歧与显而易见混为一谈；而且原文的分歧点是 learned or genetic（天生还是习得），不是 inevitability（必然性），偷换了概念。

The consequence of psychological investigation.中 psychological investigation 在P1里找不到对应——第 1 段只提到 psychologists in disagreement，没有提任何 investigation 的 consequence；且 consequence（后果）也不是原文 effect 的对应词。属凭空捏造。
The effect of human drives.借了human drives这个词，但 human drives 出现在第 2 段心理学内部解释里，是"竞争"的原因之一；题干问的是"在当代生活各领域中容易见到的东西"，对应第 1 段尾句，而非第 2 段。属张冠李戴。
预判落在"竞争在当代生活中产生的影响"上，The impact of competition.就是它的最简同义改写，词义、对象、范围都对得上。

pairs.orig: the effect competition is exerting in academics and many other areas of contemporary life

questions.stem: According to psychology, what do people strive to do following the initial stage of their life?
questions.stem_zh: 根据心理学,人们在生命的初始阶段之后努力做什么?

options.text: Fulfill individual needs without incurring adverse effects of human drives.
options.zh: 满足个人需求而不招致人类驱动力的不良影响。

options.text: Indulge in cultural pursuits while keeping their base impulses at bay.
options.zh: 沉溺于文化追求的同时抑制其基本冲动。

options.text: Gain extensive recognition without exposing pure indulgence.
options.zh: 获得广泛认可而不暴露纯粹的放纵。

options.text: Satisfy their own desires while observing social conventions.
options.zh: 在遵守社会习俗的同时满足自己的欲望。

questions.判型: 题干According to psychology, what do people strive to do following the initial stage of their life?问"心理学认为人在初始阶段之后努力做什么"，要的是具体行为描述，属于细节题。
questions.拆句: Q52主干是 what do people strive to do；According to psychology 是来源状语；following the initial stage of their life 是介词短语作时间状语。strive to do = 努力去做，注意题干问的是"努力的内容"而不是"努力的结果"。
questions.定位: P2 Thereafter, we are at the mercy of a battle between our base impulses for self-fulfillment and social and cultural norms which prohibit pure indulgence. 在那之后，我们便受制于一场拉锯战——一边是我们自我满足的本能冲动，另一边是禁止纯粹放纵的社会与文化规范。

locate.en: Thereafter, we are at the mercy of a battle between our base impulses for self-fulfillment and social and cultural norms which prohibit pure indulgence.
locate.zh: 在那之后，我们便受制于一场拉锯战——一边是我们自我满足的本能冲动，另一边是禁止纯粹放纵的社会与文化规范。

option_analysis.note: Fulfill individual needs without incurring adverse effects of human drives.把原文中的两个对立面（本能冲动 vs 社会规范）改写成"满足需求且不引发本能冲动的负面效应"——但原文里 human drives 本身是积极的追求自我满足的力量，不是"会带来负面后果的东西"；且原文中真正的对立面是 social/cultural norms，与 human drives 无关。属与原文相反兼偷换概念。
Indulge in cultural pursuits while keeping their base impulses at bay.中"沉湎于文化追求、压制本能冲动"完全把原文反过来——原文说的是文化规范禁止放纵、人的本能冲动想要放纵；选项却说人沉湎在文化里、压制本能。属与原文相反。

Gain extensive recognition without exposing pure indulgence.把"获得广泛认可"放在答案核心——但 recognition 对应的是we compete for the attention of our parents的初始阶段，是题干所问"之后"的前一阶段，时段错位；且 extensive（广泛）也是对 attention of our parents 的过度扩大。属张冠李戴。
预判要求同时包含"追求自我欲望"和"受社会规范约束"两端，且两端关系是同时进行的"边追求边受约束"；Satisfy their own desires while observing social conventions.的 while 把两端缝在一起，与原文 a battle between ... and ... 等值。

pairs.orig: social and cultural norms which prohibit pure indulgence

questions.stem: What do we learn about the "natural world" characterized by Thomas Hobbes?
questions.stem_zh: 关于Thomas Hobbes所描述的"自然世界",我们了解到什么?

options.text: It gets misrepresented by philosophers and anthropologists.
options.zh: 它被哲学家和人类学家错误地呈现。

options.text: It gets distorted in Darwin's The Origin of Species.
options.zh: 它在Darwin的《物种起源》中被扭曲。

options.text: It is free from the rational intervention of humans.
options.zh: 它不受人类理性干预的影响。

options.text: It is the pre-rational world rarely appreciated nowadays.
options.zh: 它是当今很少被欣赏的前理性世界。

questions.判型: 题干What do we learn about the "natural world" characterized by Thomas Hobbes?问"我们从原文中了解到 Hobbes 所刻画的自然世界是什么"，要的是对术语含义的复述，属于细节题。
questions.拆句: Q53主干是 What do we learn about the "natural world"；characterized by Thomas Hobbes 是过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 natural world，含义="由 Hobbes 所刻画的"。这里要扣的是 Hobbes 给 natural world 下的定义，不是后人的评价。
questions.定位: P3 Thomas Hobbes, one of the great philosophers of the seventeenth century, is perhaps best remembered for his characterization of the "natural world," that is, the world before the imposition of the will of humanity, as being "nasty, brutish, and short." Thomas Hobbes 这位 17 世纪的大哲学家，最为人记得的或许是他对"自然世界"——也就是人类意志介入之前的世界——的刻画："令人厌恶、野蛮且短暂"。

locate.en: Thomas Hobbes, one of the great philosophers of the seventeenth century, is perhaps best remembered for his characterization of the "natural world," that is, the world before the imposition of the will of humanity, as being "nasty, brutish, and short."
locate.zh: Thomas Hobbes 这位 17 世纪的大哲学家，最为人记得的或许是他对"自然世界"——也就是人类意志介入之前的世界——的刻画："令人厌恶、野蛮且短暂"。

option_analysis.note: It gets misrepresented by philosophers and anthropologists.说自然世界被哲学家和人类学家"歪曲表述"——但原文只说 Hobbes 这一形象"被达尔文的工作强化"（reinforced by Charles Darwin's highly influential work），后来又说当代人类学研究"质疑了这一观点"（questioned），并没有说 Hobbes 关于 natural world 的描述被哲学家和人类学家共同歪曲。属无中生有。

It gets distorted in Darwin's The Origin of Species.说自然世界在达尔文的书里被歪曲——但原文是This image of the pre-rational world is still widely held, reinforced by Charles Darwin's highly influential work，达尔文是"加强"而非"歪曲"，方向相反。属与原文相反。
预判要求答案体现"无人类理性介入"这一特征；It is free from the rational intervention of humans.正是同位语的直接同义改写——free from 完美匹配 before（按时间顺序的不及）。

pairs.orig: the world before the imposition of the will of humanity
pairs.opt: It is free from the rational intervention of humans.

option_analysis.note: It is the pre-rational world rarely appreciated nowadays.说 pre-rational world"当今很少受到欣赏"——但原文紧接着说This image of the pre-rational world is still widely held，明确说这一形象"仍被广泛持有"，与选项的 rarely 完全对立。属与原文相反。

questions.stem: What can we conclude from Darwin's assertion in The Origin of Species?
questions.stem_zh: 从Darwin在《物种起源》中的论断我们可以得出什么结论?

options.text: All species inherently depend on others for survival.
options.zh: 所有物种本质上都依赖其他物种生存。

options.text: Struggles for survival do not exclude mutual support.
options.zh: 生存斗争并不排斥相互支持。

options.text: Competition weighs as much as cooperation as a survival strategy.
options.zh: 作为生存策略,竞争与合作同等重要。

options.text: The strongest species proves to be the fittest in natural selection.
options.zh: 最强的物种被证明是自然选择中最适合的。

questions.判型: 题干What can we conclude from Darwin's assertion in The Origin of Species?用 conclude from 引导，要求从达尔文的断言中得出结论，属于"一步推断题"。
questions.拆句: Q54主干是 What can we conclude from Darwin's assertion；in The Origin of Species 是地点状语限定该断言出自哪本书。conclude from 重在"从断言本身推出"，所以答案必须紧贴 Darwin 那句原话，不能拿别的句子做依据。
questions.定位: P3 Darwin asserted in The Origin of Species that the struggles he was describing should be viewed as metaphors and could easily include dependence and cooperation. 达尔文在《物种起源》中断言：他所描述的那些斗争应当被视为隐喻，完全可以涵盖依赖与合作。

locate.en: Darwin asserted in The Origin of Species that the struggles he was describing should be viewed as metaphors and could easily include dependence and cooperation.
locate.zh: 达尔文在《物种起源》中断言：他所描述的那些斗争应当被视为隐喻，完全可以涵盖依赖与合作。

option_analysis.note: All species inherently depend on others for survival.中 All species（所有物种）+ inherently（天生地）是绝对化用语；原文只是说"斗争可以包含依赖与合作"，并未推出"所有物种都天生依赖他者才能生存"。属过度推断。
预判说斗争不排斥互助；Struggles for survival do not exclude mutual support.中 do not exclude 与原文 could include 等值，mutual support 概括 dependence and cooperation，逻辑等值、范围一致。

pairs.orig: the struggles he was describing should be viewed as metaphors and could easily include dependence and cooperation
pairs.opt: Struggles for survival do not exclude mutual support.

option_analysis.note: Competition weighs as much as cooperation as a survival strategy.中"竞争与合作作为生存策略权重相当"，把两者并列等值——但原文只说斗争"可以包含"合作，并未在"权重相当"的层面比较两者；权重比较是凭空引入。属过度推断。

The strongest species proves to be the fittest in natural selection.说"最强的物种被证明是最适合的"——但原文的关键点是"survival of the fittest 这个短语达尔文自己从未使用"，且本句要的是"Darwin's assertion"（达尔文的断言），不是社会上对"适者生存"的概括；况且 fittest 也不等于 strongest，原文专门指出自然选择并不暗示竞争才是最优策略。属偷换概念。

questions.stem: What conclusion did Margaret Mead reach after studying dozens of different cultures?
questions.stem_zh: Margaret Mead在研究了数十种不同文化后得出了什么结论?

options.text: It is characteristic of humans to be competitive.
options.zh: 具有竞争性是人类的特征。

options.text: Americans are uniquely opposed to cooperation.
options.zh: 美国人独特地反对合作。

options.text: Competition is relatively more prevalent in Western societies.
options.zh: 竞争在西方社会中相对更为普遍。

options.text: People's attitude towards competition is actually culture-bound.
options.zh: 人们对竞争的态度实际上受文化束缚。

questions.判型: 题干What conclusion did Margaret Mead reach after studying dozens of different cultures?问"Mead 得出了什么结论"，是对原文最后一句明文表达的结论的复述，属于细节题。
questions.拆句: Q55主干是 What conclusion did Margaret Mead reach；after studying dozens of different cultures 是时间状语。注意问的是"Mead 的结论"，所以答案必须是 Mead's final conclusion 那一句的同义改写，而不是 Mead 研究过程的具体发现（那是中间结论，不是 final conclusion）。
questions.定位: P4 After studying dozens of such cultures, Mead's final conclusion was that competitiveness is a culturally created aspect of human behavior, and that its prevalence in a particular society is relative to how that society values it. 在研究了数十个这样的文化之后，Mead 的最终结论是：竞争性是人类行为中由文化塑造出的一面；它在某个具体社会中的普遍程度，取决于该社会对它的评价。

locate.en: After studying dozens of such cultures, Mead's final conclusion was that competitiveness is a culturally created aspect of human behavior, and that its prevalence in a particular society is relative to how that society values it.
locate.zh: 在研究了数十个这样的文化之后，Mead 的最终结论是：竞争性是人类行为中由文化塑造出的一面；它在某个具体社会中的普遍程度，取决于该社会对它的评价。

option_analysis.note: It is characteristic of humans to be competitive.说"竞争是人类的天性"——但这正是 Mead 想要驳斥的观点，Mead 的结论恰恰相反：竞争性不是天生的，而是文化塑造的。属与原文相反。
Americans are uniquely opposed to cooperation.说美国人"独一无二地反对合作"——但原文是Americans uniquely praise competition as natural, inevitable, and desirable，说美国人独一无二地"赞美竞争"，并未说他们反对合作；"赞美 X"与"反对 Y"不可直接对调。属偷换概念。
Competition is relatively more prevalent in Western societies.说"竞争在西方社会中相对更普遍"——但 Mead 的最终结论是"竞争普遍程度取决于社会评价"，并未把社会分成"西方/非西方"两类、也未声称"竞争在西方更普遍"是普遍规律。属过度推断兼以偏概全。
预判要求答案体现"竞争性受文化决定"；People's attitude towards competition is actually culture-bound.中 culture-bound 直接等值于 culturally created，是 Mead 结论的最简同义改写。

pairs.orig: competitiveness is a culturally created aspect of human behavior
pairs.opt: People's attitude towards competition is actually culture-bound.

pairs.orig: its prevalence in a particular society is relative to how that society values it

translation.title: 2023年12月·第2套英语六级汉译英（段落翻译） · 中国人口老龄化的现状与应对 参考译文与解析
translation.directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to translate a passage from Chinese into English. You should write your answer on Answer Sheet 2.
translation.source_zh: 随着经济与社会的发展，中国人口结构发生了显著变化，逐渐步入老龄化社会。中国老年人口将持续增加，人口老龄化趋势将更加明显。为了应对人口老龄化带来的种种挑战，国家正积极采取措施，加大对养老的支持。通过改革社会保障(social security)制度，政府不断增加社会保障经费，逐步扩大社会保障覆盖范围，使更多老年人受益。政府还鼓励各种社会团体为老年人提供服务。在政府和社会团体的共同努力下，老年人将生活得更加幸福。
translation.reference_en:
With the development of the economy and society, China’s population structure has undergone remarkable changes and is gradually entering an aging society. China’s elderly population will continue to increase, and the trend of population aging will become more pronounced. To cope with the various challenges brought by population aging, the country is actively taking measures to increase its support for elderly care. By reforming the social security system, the government keeps increasing social security funding and gradually expanding its coverage, so that more elderly people can benefit. In addition, the government encourages various social organizations to provide services for the elderly. With the joint efforts of the government and social organizations, the elderly will live a happier life.
【衔接】
第1、2句之间：用代词/省略避免重复 population aging两句都谈人口老龄化，第1句末 an aging society 与第2句 the trend of population aging 紧挨。第2句可保留 the trend of population aging 点明趋势，但若觉重复，可把第2句首处理为 As a result, China’s elderly population will keep growing，用 As a result 显出『正步入老龄化→老年人口将增加』的因果，比单纯并列更连贯。
第3句承上：补 To address this/these challenges 显应对逻辑第3句 为了应对人口老龄化带来的种种挑战 本身已含『应对』的过渡含义，承接第2句『趋势更明显』的隐含问题。保留 To cope with the various challenges… 句首即可自然衔接，无需额外加词；这是中文已自带逻辑词、英文照译即连贯的情形。
第4、5句之间：用 In addition / also 显递进第4句讲政府改革社保『增加经费、扩大覆盖』，第5句 政府还鼓励各种社会团体 的『还』字是递进信号。第5句已用 also 译出『还』（The government also encourages…），逻辑显化到位；若想更书面，可句首加 In addition, the government encourages…。
末句总结：保留 With the joint efforts… 作收束第6句 在政府和社会团体的共同努力下 回指前文政府与社会团体两方主体，是全篇的总结性收尾。With the joint efforts of the government and social organizations 开头既承接上文两个施动者、又领出结论，是天然的收束衔接，无需另加关联词。

cohesion.core: 第1、2句之间：用代词/省略避免重复 population aging
cohesion.detail: 两句都谈人口老龄化，第1句末 an aging society 与第2句 the trend of population aging 紧挨。第2句可保留 the trend of population aging 点明趋势，但若觉重复，可把第2句首处理为 As a result, China’s elderly population will keep growing，用 As a result 显出『正步入老龄化→老年人口将增加』的因果，比单纯并列更连贯。

cohesion.core: 第3句承上：补 To address this/these challenges 显应对逻辑
cohesion.detail: 第3句 为了应对人口老龄化带来的种种挑战 本身已含『应对』的过渡含义，承接第2句『趋势更明显』的隐含问题。保留 To cope with the various challenges… 句首即可自然衔接，无需额外加词；这是中文已自带逻辑词、英文照译即连贯的情形。

cohesion.core: 第4、5句之间：用 In addition / also 显递进
cohesion.detail: 第4句讲政府改革社保『增加经费、扩大覆盖』，第5句 政府还鼓励各种社会团体 的『还』字是递进信号。第5句已用 also 译出『还』（The government also encourages…），逻辑显化到位；若想更书面，可句首加 In addition, the government encourages…。

cohesion.core: 末句总结：保留 With the joint efforts… 作收束
cohesion.detail: 第6句 在政府和社会团体的共同努力下 回指前文政府与社会团体两方主体，是全篇的总结性收尾。With the joint efforts of the government and social organizations 开头既承接上文两个施动者、又领出结论，是天然的收束衔接，无需另加关联词。

main_idea.core: 中国人口老龄化的现状与应对
main_idea.detail: 这段在客观介绍一个正在发生、并将持续的社会现象——中国步入老龄化以及政府的应对举措。开篇 随着经济与社会的发展，中国人口结构发生了显著变化，逐渐步入老龄化社会 就是典型的「陈述事实 + 趋势」语体，属社会现象介绍类，不是讲一段已经结束的历史故事。语体定下来，时态和用词风格也就跟着定了：客观、平实、不带个人情绪。

tense.detail: 通篇在客观陈述中国当下的人口现状与政府正在做的事，是「现在的事实 / 现状」，故全篇主时态用一般现在时。注意原文有大量「将」字 中国老年人口将持续增加、人口老龄化趋势将更加明显、老年人将生活得更加幸福，这些是对未来的预测，需局部改用一般将来时（will），但不影响「现在」作为全篇基调。

term_notes.detail: 统一译为 population aging（或 the aging of the population）。这是本篇反复出现的核心词 逐渐步入老龄化社会、人口老龄化趋势将更加明显、应对人口老龄化带来的种种挑战，属约定俗成的固定译法，全篇只用这一种，不要一会儿 aging 一会儿 getting old。
原文已给出英文 社会保障\(social security\)制度，故统一用 social security system。括号里的 social security 是出题方给的指定译法，必须采用，不要自创 social insurance 之类。
统一译为 the elderly（或 elderly people / older people）。本篇多处出现 使更多老年人受益、为老年人提供服务、老年人将生活得更加幸福，全篇用同一种译法，避免 old men（含轻蔑/仅指男性）这类误译。
统一译为 social organizations（或 social groups）。出现于 鼓励各种社会团体为老年人提供服务 与 在政府和社会团体的共同努力下，前后须用同一译名。

steps.text: 人口结构作主语 + 发生变化作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）中文有明确主语 中国人口结构，核心动词是 发生了显著变化，定英文主干为 China’s population structure has undergone remarkable changes。「随着经济与社会的发展」是伴随状语，不进主干。
随着…降级为 with 介词短语 + 步入老龄化降级为并列谓语随着经济与社会的发展 降级成介词短语 With the economic and social development 放句首作状语；逐渐步入老龄化社会 与前面「发生变化」是同一主语的连续动作，降级成并列谓语 and is gradually entering an aging society，用 and 连接、不另起一句。

时态「发生了变化」是到现在为止已出现、且影响延续至今的变化，用现在完成时 has undergone，比一般过去时更贴；「逐渐步入」是正在进行的趋势，用现在进行时 is entering，与全篇现在时基调一致。 单复数「显著变化」不止一处，用复数 changes；society 在 an aging society 中特指一种社会形态，用单数加冠词 an。 用词「显著」用 remarkable / significant；「逐渐」用 gradually，对应 逐渐步入，别漏译这个程度副词。
With the development of the economy and society, China’s population structure has undergone remarkable changes and is gradually entering an aging society.
两个分句各有主语、各立一套主谓（主语策略：原句主语）这是两个并列分句，各有明确主语：中国老年人口（China’s elderly population）配谓语 will continue to increase；人口老龄化趋势（the trend of population aging）配谓语 will become more pronounced。
本句结构简单、两并列分句直接 and 连接无需复杂降级，两个「主语 + will + 动词」的分句用 and 平接即可：…will continue to increase, and the trend of population aging will become more pronounced。这是少数适合用 and 直接并列的场合，因为两边确是结构对称的独立陈述。

时态两个「将」字 将持续增加、将更加明显 都是对未来的预测，偏离全篇现在时基调，改用一般将来时 will continue / will become。这正是基调允许的『确有需要处偏离』。 单复数与主谓一致population 作整体概念用单数，谓语 will continue 不受影响（will 无人称变化，但还原 increases 时须配单数）；the trend 单数特指这一趋势，加定冠词 the。 用词「更加明显」译 more pronounced / more obvious / more evident，比直译 more clear 地道；「持续增加」用 continue to increase / keep growing。
China’s elderly population will continue to increase, and the trend of population aging will become more pronounced.
国家作主语 + 采取措施作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）主语是 国家（the country / the government），核心动作是 正积极采取措施，定主干 the country is actively taking measures。「为了应对…挑战」是目的状语，「加大对养老的支持」是采取措施的具体内容/目的，均不进主干。

为了应对…降级为 to 不定式 + 加大支持降级为 to 不定式/并列为了应对人口老龄化带来的种种挑战 降级成 To cope with the various challenges brought by population aging 作句首目的状语，其中「带来的」用过去分词 brought by 作后置定语修饰 challenges；加大对养老的支持 是采取措施的目的，可降级成 to increase its support for elderly care，与主句构成「采取措施以加大支持」。

时态「正积极采取措施」是当下正在进行的动作，用现在进行时 is actively taking，贴合「正」字，也合全篇现在时基调。 单复数「种种挑战」强调多种，用复数 challenges，搭配 various；measures 采取多项措施用复数。 介词搭配「应对挑战」用 cope with / deal with / address；「对养老的支持」用 support for（不是 support to）；「养老」译 elderly care / old-age care。
To cope with the various challenges brought by population aging, the country is actively taking measures to increase its support for elderly care.
政府作主语 + 增加经费、扩大范围作并列谓语（主语策略：原句主语）主语是 政府（the government），有两个并列核心动作：不断增加社会保障经费、逐步扩大社会保障覆盖范围，定主干 the government keeps increasing the social security funding and gradually expanding its coverage。

通过…降级为 by 短语 + 使…受益降级为 so that 从句/分词通过改革社会保障\(social security\)制度 是手段，降级成 By reforming the social security system 作方式状语放句首；使更多老年人受益 是前面动作的结果，降级成结果状语，用 so that more elderly people can benefit 或现在分词 benefiting more elderly people 挂在主句后。

时态「不断增加」「逐步扩大」是持续进行的现状，用一般现在时 keeps increasing / gradually expands，合全篇基调。 单复数与受益主体「更多老年人」用复数 more elderly people；「受益」用 benefit（不及物，benefit from 或单用 benefit），主语是老年人，写成 more elderly people can benefit。 用词与冠词「社会保障经费」译 social security funding / funds；「覆盖范围」译 coverage，特指该制度的覆盖面用 its coverage；「逐步」gradually、「不断」continuously / keep doing，对应 不断增加、逐步扩大 不漏译程度词。
By reforming the social security system, the government keeps increasing social security funding and gradually expanding its coverage, so that more elderly people can benefit.
政府作主语 + 鼓励作谓语 + 社会团体作宾语（主语策略：原句主语）主语 政府，核心动词 鼓励，宾语 各种社会团体，定主干 the government also encourages various social organizations。后面「为老年人提供服务」是社会团体要做的事。
为老年人提供服务降级为 to 不定式作宾补为老年人提供服务 降级成不定式 to provide services for the elderly，作宾语 social organizations 的补足语，构成 encourage…to do 结构，无需另起分句。

时态「鼓励」是政府当前的做法，用一般现在时 encourages，第三人称单数主语 the government 后动词加 s，合全篇基调。 主谓一致主语 the government 是第三人称单数，谓语用 encourages（加 s），是主体考生常漏的一致问题。 介词搭配「为老年人提供服务」用 provide services for the elderly（provide sth for sb）或 provide the elderly with services（provide sb with sth），两种搭配都对，别混成 provide services to 之外的乱搭。
The government also encourages various social organizations to provide services for the elderly.
老年人作主语 + 生活得更幸福作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）主语是 老年人（the elderly），核心是 将生活得更加幸福，定主干 the elderly will live a happier life / the elderly will live more happily。「在…共同努力下」是条件/方式状语，不进主干。
在共同努力下降级为 with 介词短语在政府和社会团体的共同努力下 降级成 With the joint efforts of the government and social organizations 作句首状语；「生活得更加幸福」用 live a happier life（形容词比较级修饰 life）或 live more happily（副词比较级）表达。

时态「将生活得更幸福」是对未来的预期，用一般将来时 will live，偏离现在时基调，与第 2 句的 will 同理。 比较级「更加幸福」要用比较级：a happier life 或 more happily，别漏掉比较级只写 happy。 专名统一与单复数social organizations 须与第 4、5 句沿用同一译法、用复数；efforts 用复数；the elderly 作主语指一类人，视作复数。
With the joint efforts of the government and social organizations, the elderly will live a happier life.
